svg.text: left_motorPololu 30:1 Metal Gearmotor 37Dx68L 12 V with 64 CPR encoder
right_motorPololu 30:1 Metal Gearmotor 37Dx68L 12 V with 64 CPR encoder
regulator_5vPololu D36V50F5 5 V 5.5 A step-down regulator
motor_driver_1Cytron MDD10A dual-channel 10 A DC motor driver
Inline ATM mini blade fuse holder
Inline ATM mini blade fuse holder
Inline ATM mini blade fuse holder
Inline ATM mini blade fuse holder
Inline ATM mini blade fuse holder
Inline ATM mini blade fuse holder
VBAT 11.1 V from SW1: load 5.651 A typical, 16.051 A peak; source 35 A cont, 70 A peak; fuse 10 A
5V 5 V from U4: load 1 A typical, 5 A peak; source 5.5 A cont, 8 A peak
Fuses: F1 10 A (everything on VBAT), F2 2 A (branch regulator_5v), F3 2 A (branch servo_bus), F4 2 A (branch head_pan_actuator), F5 2 A (branch
left_arm_shoulder_pitch_actuator), F6 2 A (branch right_arm_shoulder_pitch_actuator). Branch fuses sit inline in the lead they protect.
Lever splices (servo_bus_hub, star_ground, splice_vbat) are junctions of their nets.
Same net label or power symbol = same conductor. X = pin not connected.
